title: Figure 36: HEL adaptive optics system for mitigating atmospheric turbulence
description: Slide titled "Mitigating the Atmosphere with Adaptive Optics" showing a Hartman sensor, computer and deformable mirror in a loop, with a BILL beam and laser beam directed toward a distant beacon through wavy atmospheric distortion. A note states "The AO System needs to operate (sense, compute, and adjust the deformable mirror) approx. > 10X faster than the atmosphere changes (~10's – 100's hz)." Captioned "Figure 36. HEL Adaptive Optics System (courtesy of the Directed Energy Professional Society)," followed by text on adapting HEL beam control to laser-propelled Lightcraft.
